title: Choose the landing page's structure
question: The world is the app's own, rendered bolder. These three structures differ in how the page persuades. Lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: What SkyrimNet Remembers
options.lineage: the app's diary dateline and memory table
options.thesis: Open on one NPC's own diary entry at reading scale, then show where it lives and how Hermaeus lets you change it.
options.viewport: A made-up NPC's diary entry in large Jost under its dateline fills the left two-thirds; the name, the one-line hook, and three download buttons sit in a column at the right; the hint strip runs along the bottom.
options.risk: If the entry reads as fiction rather than as SkyrimNet's data, the visitor misses the product; it needs its file and row stated beside it.

raised.raise: As you scroll, the screen in focus brightens and the rest of the page dims behind it.

options.label: The Character Sheet
options.lineage: the app's character Overview, annotated like a field guide
options.thesis: One made-up NPC's Overview, drawn at large scale as the real interface, with every part labeled with what Hermaeus can read or change there.
materials: the app's own screen at large scale
options.viewport: The app's top bar and an NPC's Overview fill the viewport at large scale; annotations in the margins name each part; the hook and the download buttons are set where the page title sits.
options.risk: Annotated screens can read as a manual rather than an offer; the hook has to land before the annotations do.

options.label: The Menu You Already Know
options.lineage: the app's shell: sections column, item table, details pane, hint strip
options.thesis: The landing page is a Hermaeus screen: features are rows in an item table, the details pane shows each one, and the arrow keys move through them.
options.viewport: Top bar with the mark and SKYRIM CLOSED; a sections column of page sections; an item table of what Hermaeus reads and edits; a details pane with a real screen and Download in its footer; the hint strip below.
options.risk: Inside a working menu, the hook can get lost; a first-time visitor needs a one-line answer before the table.
